Surfaces.Contract: Start the caller owner before validation or command construction. Keep it through dispatch, native result inspection, typed conversion and cleanup. Delegated methods borrow it; cache hits and successful calls keep the default failure-only owner.

Start the caller owner before validation or command construction. Keep it through dispatch, native result inspection, typed conversion and cleanup. Delegated methods borrow it; cache hits and successful calls keep the default failure-only owner.

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the acquisition caller owner through validation, SET conversion and managed handle construction. Contention conversion and keep-alive startup remain inside the outer caller boundary.
Boundaries.Name: native-lock-acquisition

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the release caller owner through identity setup, capability fallback, routing and fencing. The handle restores or loses ownership and unwraps non-submission before final publication.
Boundaries.Name: native-lock-managed-release

Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the renewal caller owner through validation, capability setup, native/Lua fallback and uncertain-command fencing. The outer handle finishes gate and deadline cleanup before publication.
Boundaries.Name: native-lock-managed-renewal
